title: crepidium lamii
intro: Crepidium lamii, commonly known as the "Lam's Pansy Orchid," is a species of orchid native to Central and South America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. Crepidium lamii's therapeutic actions include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents responsible for its properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which have been identified in various studies.
